name: TGIF (The Good Instructor Frenzy)
source:
The new school instructor in town is now teaching at Queen Stone Academy with a lot of hot girls. And back home, he has the best female neighbors. Join the roller coaster ride of our protagonist, who finds himself in the middle of an interesting but challenging daily life.​

Step into the world of the newest instructor at Queen Stone Academy, where academic challenges and steamy encounters blend seamlessly. This isn't just a teaching job – it's an experience brimming with unexpected twists, casual fun, and a touch of the familiar. From the stunning and adventurous students to the equally captivating colleagues, every day brings a new mix of professional duties, flirtatious adventures, and opportunities to explore various fetishes and desires. Join our protagonist on this roller coaster ride, navigating a life where each turn brings excitement, temptation, and a rich tapestry of intriguing relationships, both in and out of the academy. Discover a world where your deepest fantasies can be indulged, and where each meeting reveals exciting and sometimes surprising sides of passion.
